title: We Completed Scorned Wilderness on Day 1...
author: Benny and the Chickenboy
description:
Two lifelong friends, Benny and the Chickenboy take on Runescape Dragonwilds' newest region, THE SCORNED WILDERNESS. This episode will cover their blind playthrough  done LIVE on Day 1 of release.

The Scorned Wilderness contains the game's first raid, new weapons and supplies, and the Final Boss of the Kuldra Saga.

If you enjoyed this series, consider liking, subscribing, and leaving a comment telling us what you think of the game!! We really appreciate the support.

Join our Discord! https://discord.gg/ANgd5B7Tbt
Dragonwilds Livestreams:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BGYF4M_PgGg&list=PLwJuV4brGwe2MsnR1TzuVOVbpcbZMDkFC

All video/picture from Jagex and music from Oldschool Runescape 
Writer: Ian Taylor
Company: Jagex
Year: 2004

#runescape #dragonwilds #survivalgame
